name: contract-discovery-skipped-cases
goal: Reject skipped and unresolved authored-case registrations during test discovery

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Generated helper and class cases must inherit skipped and unresolved registrar or enclosing suite contexts.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The existing TestDiscoveryService.discover case checks top-level registration only; it misses disabled and conditional registrars and inherited suite modifiers.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Committed case 7ffa041d12 failed: test.skip registration was marked enabled; immutable checkpoint ec10cb1f1fff.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Runner context now carries suite titles, disabled modifiers and unresolved control flow into generated case declarations.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: The unchanged discovery case passed at 8ab8e3be39 under the same command and environment as checkpoint ec10cb1f1fff.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
